lyricReasons.text-changed: The original text of this line changed in the lyrics file (the file was replaced)
lyricReasons.invalid-segmentation: The word segmentation does not spell the original text

opReasons.anchor-missing: The shot or section it was attached to no longer exists (lyrics, sections or seed changed)
opReasons.pack-mismatch: The style belongs to another pack and shot mixing is off for this section
opReasons.component-unknown: This shot's pack has no such component or option (the pack or style may have changed)

shotStyle: The style lock of the shot at line {{n}} ({{style}}) no longer applies
shotComponent: The component setting of the shot at line {{n}} ({{slot}} = {{value}}) no longer applies
transition: The transition setting of the section starting at line {{n}} no longer applies
direction: The arrangement setting of the section starting at line {{n}} no longer applies
directionDetail: The line no longer exists, its text changed, or it no longer starts a section
kind: The type setting of the section starting at line {{n}} no longer applies
split: The manual split at line {{n}} no longer applies
merge: The manual merge at line {{n}} no longer applies

structureReasons.lineMissing: The line no longer exists or its text changed
structureReasons.firstLine: The first line always starts a section
structureReasons.notStart: This line no longer starts a section

clipAssetMissing: The media is no longer in the library
clipAnchorMissing: The lyric lines / section / shot it was attached to no longer exist (you can switch it to a fixed time)
background: A background clip is not shown
backgroundAssetMissing: Its image or video is no longer in the library
backgroundAnchorMissing: The section it follows no longer exists (you can switch it to the whole song or a fixed time)
lyricEdit: The lyric edit of line {{n}} no longer applies
segmentation: The manual segmentation of line {{n}} no longer applies
segmentationStale: After the text edit the segmentation no longer spells the new text (automatic segmentation is used for now)
